一九七一年六月一日，又到了开门办学的时候。

这次去的是首钢。北京医学院根据开门办学方针，安排医疗系医疗七班三十四名工农兵学员全部下厂学工。王建新带领原班小组——刘晓东、李建国、郭强、张树清、孙长河、周小梅、陈秀英，加上他自己一共八人，作为医疗队进驻首钢，与厂医务室联合开展医疗工作。

钢铁厂是典型的高危行业，企业每年死亡事故都不少。煤气中毒、烫伤、砸伤等工伤事故屡见不鲜。而工厂医务室普遍缺医少药，技术水平有限。因此，王建新医疗队被分配到首钢，对厂方而言是一次难得的技术外援。

这次学校把他们送到火车站。一行八人坐着一辆绿皮火车，沿着京张铁路线向西驶去。车窗外的景色从城区的灰砖楼房渐渐变成郊区的田野，远处的天际线越来越开阔。偶尔能看见几座高耸的烟囱，冒着白色的蒸汽。

“队长，快看！”刘晓东趴在车窗上，指着远处，“那不就是石景山吗？”

王建新朝窗外看去。晨光中，几座高炉巍然耸立，浓烟从烟囱里滚滚升腾，把东边的半边天都染成了灰黄色。即便隔着几里地，也能感受到那股扑面而来的工业气息。那是钢铁厂独有的味道——不是一种味道，是好几种味道混在一起：焦炭的焦糊味、铁矿石的土腥味、还有某种说不清道不明的化学气味。

一个多小时后，火车停在石景山站。八个人拎着帆布挎包、背着行李下了车。一股热浪拱着铁锈味迎面扑来，像一只看不见的手捂住了口鼻。刘晓东连打了两个喷嚏，揉了揉鼻子，皱着一张脸说：“我的乖乖，这什么味啊？铁锈、焦炭，还有——”

“煤烟。”郭强深吸了一口气，像是在回味什么，“跟老家烧炕的味一模一样，就是大了几十倍。”

“那是你没去过炼钢车间。”李建国推了推眼镜，一脸过来人的表情，“在里边待上半小时，出来鼻孔都是黑的。”

八个人出了站，居然没看到来接他们的人。王建新站在站前左右看了看，除了几个等车的乘客和一辆快要开走的公交车，什么也没有。他说：“走吧，反正离得也不远。”心想看来这工农兵走哪儿也不受欢迎啊。

几个人沿着灰扑扑的道路往前走。路是柏油路，但上面覆着一层细细的黑色粉末，脚踩上去沙沙响。越靠近厂区，声音越大——轰隆声、哐当声、尖锐的金属撞击声交织在一起，像一台永不停歇的巨型机器在咆哮。地面也在微微颤动，像是地底下有什么东西在翻身。

厂区大门是一道高大的铁门，铁门上方架着红旗，红旗被风吹得猎猎作响。门口挂着一块牌子，白底红字——“首都钢铁公司”。门口站着两个保卫科人员，穿着蓝制服，胳膊上戴着红袖章。看见他们走过来，其中一个上前一步，伸出手拦住他们。

“同志，你们是？”

On June 1, 1971, it was time to open the school again.

This time I went to Shougang.In accordance with the open-door policy, Beijing Medical College arranged for all 34 workers, peasants, and soldiers from Class 7 of the Medical Department to go to the factory to study as workers.Wang Jianxin led the original team - Liu Xiaodong, Li Jianguo, Guo Qiang, Zhang Shuqing, Sun Changhe, Zhou Xiaomei, Chen Xiuying, plus himself, a total of eight people, as a medical team stationed in Shougang, and jointly carried out medical work with the factory clinic.

Steel plants are a typical high-risk industry, and there are many fatal accidents every year.Work-related accidents such as gas poisoning, burns, and bruises are common.However, factory clinics are generally short of doctors and medicines, and their technical level is limited.Therefore, Wang Jianxin's medical team was assigned to Shougang, which was a rare technical foreign aid for the factory.

This time the school sent them to the train station.A group of eight people sat on a green train and headed west along the Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway Line.The scenery outside the car window gradually changes from the gray brick buildings in the city to the fields in the suburbs, and the skyline in the distance becomes wider and wider.Occasionally, you can see several tall chimneys, emitting white steam.

"Captain, look!" Liu Xiaodong leaned against the car window and pointed into the distance, "Isn't that Shi Jingshan?"

Wang Jianxin looked out the window.In the morning light, several blast furnaces stood majestically, and thick smoke billowed from their chimneys, dyeing half of the sky in the east gray-yellow.Even from a few miles away, you can still feel the industrial atmosphere.It was a smell unique to steel plants—not one smell, but several smells mixed together: the burnt smell of coke, the earthy smell of iron ore, and some inexplicable chemical smell.

More than an hour later, the train stopped at Shijingshan Station.Eight people got out of the car carrying canvas satchels and luggage.A heat wave rushed towards me with the smell of rust, like an invisible hand covering my mouth and nose.Liu Xiaodong sneezed twice in a row, rubbed his nose, wrinkled his face and said, "My dear, what does this smell like? Rust, coke, and -"

"Soot." Guo Qiang took a deep breath, as if recollecting something, "It's exactly the same as the smell of burning a kang in my hometown, but it's dozens of times stronger."

"That's because you haven't been to the steel-making workshop." Li Jianguo pushed up his glasses with an expression like someone who had been there before, "If you stay there for half an hour, your nostrils will be black when you come out."

The eight people left the station, but no one came to pick them up.Wang Jianxin stood in front of the station and looked around. There was nothing except a few waiting passengers and a bus that was about to leave.He said: "Let's go, it's not far away anyway." He thought to himself that it seems that these workers, peasants and soldiers are not welcome wherever they go.

Several people walked along the dusty road.The road is asphalt, but it is covered with a fine layer of black powder, which makes a rustling sound when you step on it.The closer we get to the factory, the louder the sound becomes - rumbles, clangs, and sharp metal collisions intertwined together, like a giant machine that never stops roaring.The ground was also shaking slightly, as if something was turning over under the ground.

The gate to the factory is a tall iron gate, with a red flag hung above the iron gate. The red flag was blown by the wind.There is a sign hanging at the door with red letters on a white background - "Capital Steel Company".There were two security officers standing at the door, wearing blue uniforms and red armbands on their arms.Seeing them approaching, one of them stepped forward and stretched out his hand to stop them.

"Comrade, who are you?"
